summary: Several studies have directly applied federated learning techniques to sepsis prediction. Fischer et al. (2023) [V0012] used a decentralised training approach without pooled records on the CellLife dataset, achieving an F1 score of 0.68. Duarte et al. (2021) [V0010] applied a similar approach on the AgriSat-4 dataset, reporting a MAE of 0.89. Chen et al. (2020) [V0009] employed decentralised training on the Atlas-ICU dataset, obtaining an accuracy of 0.82. Fischer et al. (2023) [V0018] used multilevel probabilistic models with partial pooling on the AgriSat-4 dataset, achieving an F1 score of 0.76. Duarte et al. (2021) [V0004] applied message passing over relational graphs on the CellLife dataset, reporting a MAE of 0.81.
